title: Concept: Template compiled from input (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, ERB.news*([^)]*(?:+|#{) turns a string into an executable template. Server-side template injection runs attacker expressions with application data access. The remedy is fixed templates with variable binding via fixed templates with result(binding).
applicability: ruby codebases compiling templates from assembled strings; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Server-side template injection leading to data theft or code execution; HIGH severity.
